question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**variance**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context tells us that boys from public schools who went to universities found it challenging to continue playing, unless they were reunited with old classmates, due to the different restrictions.
 
• "**Variance**" fits well as it elaborates the complexity of the game.
 
• Other options ("**grouse**", "**similarity**", "**control**") do not fit the context of this sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Grouse (शिकायत):** It means a complaint, which does not fit the context of discussing forest fire hazards.
 
• **Similarity (समानता****): **The state of being like somebody/something but not exactly the same
 
• **Control (नियंत्रण): **The power to influence or direct behavior, which does not align with describing the risk posed by forest fires.
